import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main',
      'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'}

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    print("ARCHIVE CONTENTS:")
    for n in z.namelist():
        print(" ", n)

    # shared strings
    shared = []
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall('m:si', NS):
            text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
            shared.append(text)
    print("\nSHARED STRINGS:")
    for i, s in enumerate(shared):
        print(f"  [{i}] {s!r}")

    # workbook sheets
    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    print("\nWORKBOOK SHEETS:")
    for sh in wb.findall('.//m:sheet', NS):
        print(f"  name={sh.get('name')!r} sheetId={sh.get('sheetId')} r:id={sh.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id')}")

    # relationships
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    relmap = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels}
    print("\nWORKBOOK RELS:", relmap)

    # dump every worksheet
    for n in sorted(z.namelist()):
        if n.startswith('xl/worksheets/') and n.endswith('.xml'):
            print(f"\n=== {n} ===")
            root = ET.fromstring(z.read(n))
            for row in root.findall('.//m:row', NS):
                rnum = row.get('r')
                cells = []
                for c in row.findall('m:c', NS):
                    ref = c.get('r')
                    t = c.get('t')
                    v = c.find('m:v', NS)
                    val = v.text if v is not None else None
                    if t == 's' and val is not None:
                        val = shared[int(val)]
                    elif t == 'inlineStr':
                        is_el = c.find('m:is', NS)
                        if is_el is not None:
                            val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in is_el.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
                    cells.append((ref, val))
                print(f"  row {rnum}: {cells}")
